verdict.rationale: Bugbot provides direct one-click handoff into Cursor's own agent ("Fix in Cursor" and "Fix in Web" opening cursor.com/agents) and posts inline PR comments with suggested fixes, satisfying the core 'review findings hand off cleanly' need for Cursor itself. However, there's no evidence of copyable fix prompts formatted for external tools, nor any direct integration with Claude Code or Codex as named in the story. missing for 10: explicit copyable fix-prompt format, direct integration/handoff to Claude Code, direct integration/handoff to Codex.
